subject.title: [Feature]: Expose sessionKey/runId to outbound message hook for deterministic verification

question: Should OpenClaw expose same-turn transcript/tool-call/result evidence to outbound pre-send plugin hooks, and what bounded, permissioned public SDK shape should own it?
rationale: The remaining work changes public plugin API semantics and may expose sensitive session/tool data before delivery, so automation cannot safely choose the field shape, redaction, permissions, or hook ownership.

options.title: Add bounded evidence contract
options.body: Expose run identity plus capped, redacted same-turn verification evidence on the chosen pre-send hook and document the permission/security model.

options.title: Document hook composition only
options.body: Treat existing tool hooks plus `reply_payload_sending` as the supported plugin path, document the pattern, and keep claim-verification packages outside core.

options.title: Land identity only first
options.body: Thread outbound runId through message hooks now while leaving transcript/tool-result evidence for a later plugin API decision.

recommendation.title: Add bounded evidence contract
recommendation.body: Expose run identity plus capped, redacted same-turn verification evidence on the chosen pre-send hook and document the permission/security model.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current signal for the product/security boundary because of the prior review and current blame on the documented hook context gaps.
